name: Smith Machine Close-Grip Bent-Over Row
steps: Face the Smith bar and grasp it overhand with your hands slightly inside shoulder width.
Release the hooks and hinge at your hips with soft knees until the bar hangs under your shoulders.
Pull the bar smoothly upward toward your lower abdomen by driving your elbows straight back close to your ribs.
Lower the bar slowly back to full arm extension while holding your torso angle steady.
tips: Keep your elbows tucked alongside your body to emphasize your lats.
Maintain a braced core and flat lower back throughout the entire set.
